argv: cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime; p=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value gts9-adbd.service); readlink /proc/$p/exe; ps -T -p "$p" -o pid,tid,comm,wchan:32; cat /sys/class/udc/a600000.usb/state; journalctl -b -u gts9-adbd --no-pager -o short-monotonic; journalctl -k -b --no-pager -o json
